hook_text: Standing at the very bottom of Africa, which way is everything?
clip_script: Cape Agulhas, the southernmost tip of Africa. A stone marker, a lighthouse, two oceans. Four compass directions become eight: north, north-east, east, south-east, south, south-west, west, north-west. North or south always comes first. Every direction starts from a fixed point. The lighthouse is north-west of the marker, so the marker is south-east of the lighthouse. And on the world map, Europe is north of Africa, Australia south-east.
visual_style: Whiteboard compass rose drawing its four long points, then four short ones, beside a lighthouse at the tip of Africa.
mood: Breezy and adventurous, like standing on a windy cliff by the sea.
pacing: One point of the compass at a time, then quick arrows across the world map.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and describe where your school is from your home using the eight points.
